description: Cluster Refusing TLS between Clients and Brokers
rationale: A cluster set to PLAINTEXT carries every produced and consumed record, and the SASL/SCRAM password of every client that authenticates, in the clear across the VPC. Anything positioned on that path reads the data stream directly: another workload on a shared subnet, a VPC flow mirroring session, a peered network, or a compromised instance running a packet capture. The setting also leaves the clients with no way to tell a broker from an impostor, so an attacker able to answer on the broker address collects the credentials the clients present.
remediation: Set the client-broker encryption of the cluster to TLS, after configuring the clients for TLS and, if needed, moving them over during a TLS_PLAINTEXT window
